card.title: How To Fix iPhone 16 Pro Max No Image With Original Screen

source.title: How To Fix iPhone 16 Pro Max No Image With Original Screen

claims.statement: iPhone 16 Pro / Pro Max that shows no image on an original OLED but works with a generic screen is missing the –10 V PNVAR_DISPLAY_VGL rail, which only original panels need.
PNVAR_DISPLAY_VGL reads about 220 mV forward and OL reverse in diode mode; with power on it should be –10 V.
If –10 V is missing and there is no short on the line, display PMIC U9400 is the usual failure and is replaced.

procedure: Inspect display FPC area and VGL filters.
Measure –10 V with the display connected and phone on.
Replace U9400 if no short; confirm –10 V and image.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
